collection.description: The village has always kept silent during planting, but a farmer wants to sing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The village has always kept silent during planting, but a farmer wants to sing.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A young farmer finds the silence lonely.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The workers enjoy the rhythm and finish together.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The noise disturbs nearby nesting birds.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The harvest ritual gains a lively ending.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some workers still wish they could sing while working.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: An elder recalls that silence once helped hear approaching storms.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: No one can verify the story, but the question inspires study.
